description: Start an ASYNC export render of a project sequence. Returns a job_id immediately (status 'queued') — does NOT block. Then poll lab_get_export with that job_id until status is done|failed. Needs the sequence_id to render (an integer from the project's sequences). `derivatives` asks for extra cut-downs of the SAME render (portrait for social) alongside the main file — their URLs come back in the finished job's `derivatives`.

derivative_region.description: Which part of the wide frame the portrait crop keeps. Default 'center' — pick 'left' or 'right' when the subject stands off to one side, otherwise the crop cuts it in half.

derivatives.description: Extra cut-downs rendered from the FINISHED export, on top of the main file. '9x16' is a deterministic crop of the wide render into portrait — what falls outside the portrait frame is gone, not filled in. Their URLs arrive in the completed job's `derivatives`.

include_stems.description: Also export audio stems separately (default false)

ki_kennzeichnung.description: How the visible AI disclosure (EU AI Act Art. 50(4)) appears when the sequence contains AI material. Default 'minimal': a small 'KI' mark in the corner for the whole film. 'durchgehend': the larger 'KI-verändert' box. 'leitfaden': an 'AI' mark top right for the whole film, as in the German regulator's (Bundesnetzagentur) transparency guide. 'anfang': the mark for the first 4 s plus a 4 s end card. 'abspann': only the 4 s end card. 'anfang' and 'abspann' require werk_kuenstlerisch=true; there is no option without any disclosure.

profile.description: Delivery profile (default 'web'). See lab_export_profiles. 'alpha_prores4444' and 'alpha_png_sequence' keep transparency and are refused with an explanation unless a clip in the sequence really carries an alpha channel.

sequence_id.description: Sequence id to render (positive integer as string, e.g. '27')

werk_kuenstlerisch.description: Confirm the work is artistic, fictional or satirical — only then may the disclosure be limited to the opening or the end card. Set it only when that is true; the choice is recorded with the export.

name: lab_start_export
title: Start Export
